name: matselect
description: MatSelect — AI-assisted, calculation-ranked material selection (NestJS + Next.js + MongoDB)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix api install && npm --prefix web install && node scripts/setup-env.mjs
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix api run dev" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix api run build && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix api run start" "npm --prefix web run start"
scripts.test: npm --prefix api test && npm --prefix api run test:e2e
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix api run typecheck && npm --prefix web run typecheck
